name: Clamshell
description: Lying on your side with knees bent and heels together, open your top knee toward the ceiling like a clamshell, then close it with control.

source.title: Side-Lying Hip External Rotation (Clamshell) (MSD Manual)
source.note: From your full-body routine, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your side on a mat, hips stacked. If your hips roll back, lie with your back against a wall.
Bend your knees to about 90°, heels together.
cues: Keep your heels touching the whole time.
Open the knee as far as you can without rolling your hips back.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Knees together
keyframes.cue: Lying on your left side, knees bent, heels together.

keyframes.name: Open
keyframes.cue: Lift your top knee toward the ceiling.
